title: copy_slides
description: Copy slides from another deck of the project into this one (move: and remove them from the other), on this deck's layouts and template; text with no place in them is kept and reported. The person approves first.

from_deck_id.description: The deck the slides come from (Decks in your context).

slide_ids.description: The slides, by their number in that deck (1 = first) or ID; get_deck_outline with its deck_id lists them.

deck_id.description: The deck they go to; left out: the active deck.

after_slide_id.description: Put them after this slide of the target (number or ID); left out: at the end.

move.description: true: remove them from the deck they come from.
